title: Predicting Radiologist Expertise from 3D Gaze Patterns During CT Interpretation
abstract: arXiv:2608.23836v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate interpretation of volumetric CT requires efficient navigation of 3D image volumes and attention to diagnostically relevant regions. While eye-tracking has been widely studied in 2D medical imaging, its use for expertise assessment in CT settings remains limited. We propose a gaze-informed transformer framework for expertise classification in thoracic CT. Using a DINOv2 backbone, radiologist fixation patterns are integrated into volumetric feature learning through (1) a learnable log-space bias in self-attention and (2) gaze-weighted pooling of patch embeddings. We trained and evaluated our approach on 182 CT reading sessions from five radiologists with varying levels of experience. On a held-out test set, the model achieves an ROC-AUC of 0.91 and F1 score of 0.86, outperforming adapted methods. These findings suggest that incorporating visual search behavior into transformers may support objective, process-based expertise asse

translated_title: 基于CT解读过程中三维注视模式预测放射科医生专业水平
translated_abstract: 摘要：准确解读容积CT需要对三维图像体积进行高效导航，并关注诊断相关区域。虽然眼动追踪在二维医学影像中已被广泛研究，但其在CT环境中用于专业水平评估的应用仍然有限。我们提出了一种基于注视信息的Transformer框架，用于胸部CT中的专业水平分类。利用DINOv2骨干网络，通过（1）自注意力中的可学习对数空间偏置和（2）基于注视加权的补丁嵌入池化，将放射科医生的注视模式整合到体积特征学习中。我们在五位不同经验水平的放射科医生进行的182次CT阅读会话上训练并评估了我们的方法。在留出测试集上，模型实现了0.91的ROC-AUC和0.86的F1分数，优于适配方法。这些发现表明，将视觉搜索行为纳入Transformer可能支持客观的、基于过程的专业水平评估。
tldr: 本文提出了一种将放射科医生3D注视模式整合进Transformer框架的新方法，通过自注意力偏置和注视加权池化，在胸部CT专业水平分类中实现了高精度（ROC-AUC 0.91），为基于过程的客观专业评估提供了新途径。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel gaze-informed transformer framework that integrates radiologists' 3D gaze patterns via self-attention bias and gaze-weighted pooling, achieving high accuracy (ROC-AUC 0.91) in chest CT expertise classification and offering a process-based approach for objective expertise assessment.
